per_shot.note: Real ceiling with ribs, fixtures and pipe runs, riveted wall panels, dusk portholes; warm and calm. Floor spill is a broad muddy wash and the foreground third is an empty slab.
Cone pools under each fixture land on the wall nicely; floor reads as large plates but lighting on it is blotchy with an odd cool-green smudge left of the suit.
Corkboard, locker and porthole give a hab identity; stock room already reads as a lived-in corridor, not a box. Dark east wall gives good contrast.
Fern, patterned rug, glowing radio dial and book shelf all read as themselves; richer than stock. Rug is small and flat relative to the room.
Arc lamp pools warmly on wall and floor; star chart is a strong focal accent. Floor wash under it is soft but smeary.
Galley with kettle and cups, bunk with pillow and bedding, wall lamp; Gallery doorway glow is inviting. Bunk bedding sinks into shadow; foreground floor patchy.

top_issues.issue: Foreground floor is a large dead slab with blotchy, shapeless light washes
top_issues.why: Bottom third of every frame is low-information plating whose light patches read as rendering smears rather than porthole or lamp spill; it dilutes the room.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Shape porthole spill as soft elongated ellipses tied to the porthole positions, keep the foreground darker and quieter, and add plate seams/value steps so the floor reads as plating.

top_issues.issue: Walls lack small lived-in hab detail between stations
top_issues.why: Panels and red stripe repeat uniformly; the hab feels tidy but slightly generic.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add sparse conduit drops, junction boxes, labels or switch plates between bays.

top_issues.issue: Some furnishings are small or under-lit at play scale
top_issues.why: Rug is a thin strip; bunk bedding goes dark maroon in shadow, so the bed reads less cosy than it could.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Give the bunk a small warm practical wash and lift the bedding value; slightly enlarge or brighten the rug pattern.

top_issues.why: A teal patch on the floor left of the suit breaks the warm palette without a visible source.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Tie it to a visible source (the console screen) or remove it.

protect: Ceiling with ribs, pipe runs and warm fixtures casting cones on the wall
Furnishings reading as themselves: fern, patterned rug, glowing radio, books, star chart, kettle and cups, bunk
Arc lamp pooling light on wall and floor
Suit remains the most legible element
Dark corners and the warm-not-grim balance

per_shot.note: Same strong shell as A plus a conduit drop with junction box; floor plates have darker seams and value steps. Porthole spill now appears as two hard round orange blobs in the foreground.
Conduit drops and junction boxes between bays and a floor grate add lived-in hab detail; round foreground light coins look like stray decals.
Floor plating reads more clearly than A; one round spill blob still floats disconnected from any source.
All furnishings read as in A; floor near the wall is darker so the rug and pieces sit better. Round spill spots remain distracting.
Richest frame: conduit, star chart, arc lamp pool, books, floor grate; warm and cared-for. Foreground coins are the main flaw.
Same galley, bunk and Gallery doorway as A; Gallery's rose spill on the floor is a nice touch. Bunk bedding still dark.

top_issues.issue: Porthole spill renders as hard circular orange coins on the foreground floor
top_issues.why: They sit far in front of the portholes with crisp round edges and read as decals or bugs, not as dusk light landing on the floor.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Stretch them into soft, elongated shapes that fall from each porthole toward the viewer, with feathered edges and lower intensity near the camera.

top_issues.issue: Foreground floor still takes a large share of the frame with little interest
top_issues.why: Even with better plating, the bottom third is mostly empty plating.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Let the foreground fall darker toward the camera edge so the eye goes to the lit wall band.

top_issues.why: The bed is the cosiest object in the room but reads as a dark maroon slab.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Lift bedding value and let the wall lamp pool onto the blanket and pillow.

top_issues.issue: Rug is small for its role
top_issues.why: Pattern reads, but it is a thin strip that barely changes the floor.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Slightly larger footprint or a warm light pool landing on it.

protect: Wall conduit drops and junction boxes between bays
Floor plating with seams, value steps and the grate hatch
Ceiling ribs, pipe runs and warm fixture cones on the wall
Dusk portholes and the Gallery doorway's rose spill
All furnishings reading as themselves, furnished room clearly richer than stock
Suit remains the most legible element

why: B adds lived-in wall conduit and better-read floor plating, which serves the hab-not-box goal; its hard round porthole spill spots are the one regression and keep the margin small.
